rules.statement: The shares of each of the three sisters under a joint will are separate interests subject to a separate fidei commissum, and devolve on their respective lawful issue without any restriction.
rules.supporting_quote: "I think that the intention, I think, is pretty clear that the share of each of the three sisters should be regarded as a separate interest subject to a separate fidei commissum, and that it should devolve 'on the lawful issue' of the respective institutes 'without any restriction whatsoever.'"
